purpose: Pair two counterparties EMIR Refit reports by UTI and reconcile the caller-supplied matching-field set (up to 148 fields per the 2026 escalation) within a configurable per-field numeric tolerance. Identifies reconciliation breaks so a firm catches the pairing failure before the Trade Repository rejects it. Feeds lifecycle event validator (art-157).
